title: JSFL addNewLayer ignores type and addAbove parameters
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts line 482, addNewLayer(name, _type?, _addAbove?) ignores both the type parameter (guide, mask, normal) and the addAbove parameter. New layers always use normal type and always insert at a default position. Fix: (1) use the type param to set the layer type via setLayerType() after creating the layer; (2) use addAbove to determine insertion order — if true, insert above the current layer, else below.
